mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orders (total, order_status, created_at, expected_delivery, created_by) VALUES (#{total}, #{order_status}, #{createdAt}, #{expectedDelivery}, #{created_by})
mapper.select: SELECT orders.id, orders.status, order_item.product_id from orders INNER JOIN order_item ON orders.id = order_item.order_id where orders.id = (#{id})
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET order_status = #{order_status}, notecancel = #{notecancel}, cancel_at = #{cancel_at}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, canceled_by = #{canceled_by} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT p.id as productId, p.name as productName, oi.price, s.sku_code AS skuCode, s.id AS skuId, p.json_images as jsonImages, cp.price as priceCampaign, cp.price_discount as priceDiscountCampaign, oi.quantity FROM order_item oi JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id LEFT JOIN product_sku s ON s.id = oi.sku_id LEFT JOIN campain_product cp ON cp.product_id = oi.product_id AND cp.sku_id = oi.sku_id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId}
SELECT id AS orderId, order_status AS order_status, created_at AS order_date, total AS total, expected_delivery AS expected_delivery, created_by AS createdBy FROM orders WHERE id = #{orderId}

SELECT oi.product_id as productId, p.name as productName, oi.price as price, oi.quantity
FROM order_item oi LEFT JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.id WHERE oi.order_id = #{orderId}
